nodes.name: Probe Balances
nodes.notes: The keep-alive and the liveness signal in one call: Enable Banking refreshes the ASPSP token during data fetches.

nodes.name: Twelve-Hourly Watch
nodes.notes: Every 12h: two watch fetches a day, which with the ingest's two stays inside the ASPSP's ~4/day background limit. Each run is a real data fetch, which is what makes Enable Banking renew the ASPSP token internally.
